en.headline: 5 commits in opencode-agent-sandbox plus 2 automated; 1 issue opened upstream
en.summary: On 2026-10-16, `sogeisetsu` made **5 own commits** in `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, all documentation-focused: adding an `AGENTS.md` file, noting the origin remote in it, creating a `knowledge/` base for Git & GitHub findings with Excalidraw sketches, generalizing the knowledge wording from Git/GitHub to "various knowledge", and making the knowledge supplement a default action with architecture adjustable to content. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, there were 0 own commits plus 2 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. No pull requests, reviews, releases, stars, or discussions were recorded. One issue was opened upstream: `anomalyco/opencode` issue #55772, titled "[FEATURE]: Windows desktop ships the CLI but there is no way to run it", which remains open. No truncation occurred in any section.

zh.headline: opencode-agent-sandbox 5 次提交加 2 次自动提交；上游新开 1 个 issue
zh.summary: 2026-10-16，`sogeisetsu` 在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 完成 **5 次本人提交**，全部为文档相关：新增 `AGENTS.md` 文件、在其中注明 origin 远程、建立 `knowledge/` 目录用于记录 Git 与 GitHub 相关发现并附 Excalidraw 草图、将 knowledge 措辞从 Git/GitHub 泛化为「各种知识」、以及把 knowledge 补充改为默认动作并允许架构随内容调整。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，本人提交 0 次，另有 2 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。当日无 PR、评审、发布、星标或讨论活动。上游新开 1 个 issue：`anomalyco/opencode` 的 #55772，标题为「[FEATURE]: Windows desktop ships the CLI but there is no way to run it」，目前仍处于 open 状态。各部分均未触发截断。
